name: file-preview
title: File preview
description: Preview any file the right way: image, PDF, video, audio or text in place, with loading and failed states, an Open PDF fallback for phones and a Download for the rest.
docs: Pass file ({ name, mime, size, url, text, poster }). The type picks the renderer: an image fitted whole, a PDF in the browser's own viewer, video and audio with the native controls, a text or code file read in place when you give text, and for anything else its icon, name, size and a Download button. Nothing is fetched for you. maxHeight caps the preview (text scrolls, and is cut after 2,000 lines). Images, video, audio and PDFs have a loading and a failed state in words with Retry; a PDF counts as failed after 15 seconds. Where the browser has no PDF viewer (most phones) a message and an Open PDF link appear; embedPdf false forces that. status loading or failed (with onRetry) is for what you fetch yourself, like a file's text. onDownload turns Download into a button that calls you. The preview is a region named by the file's name and type. labels and locale translate.
